site.name: solstice-bank
site.summary: solstice-bank-clone Fictional digital bank "Solstice Bank" account-opening flow, aimed at the freelancer segment. Pages | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `index.html` | Landing: hero (with two decorative credit cards) + three value props + "Materials to prepare" checklist + top CTA to apply | | `apply.html` | Single-page 8-step linear account-opening flow with section switching: 1 eligibility + ToS / 2 personal info (name, DOB, masked SSN) / 3 contact and US address / 4 employment and income (incl. freelance / self-employed) / 5 ID verification (front/back photo upload mock + modal liveness 3-2-1 countdown) / 6 risk questionnaire (5 questions, with soft warning when compared against income) / 7 funding choice (link external bank mock OAuth, mailed check, fund later) + 4 fictional banks / 8 review (each section has Edit to jump back). Top progress bar + step dots (completed steps clickable to go back, unfinished locked). Save & continue later, Cancel application second-confirmation. Bottom-right floating Help drawer with copy that changes per step. | | `confirmation.html` | Application submission success: animated checkmark + random application number `SOL-2026-XXXX-XX` + next-step

run_plan.goal: Execute a comprehensive UX audit of the Solstice Bank onboarding flow, validating the 8-step linear application process, error handling, and mobile responsiveness.
run_plan.summary: The run will begin by auditing the landing page for accessibility issues (specifically tap targets), then proceed to execute a full end-to-end application submission through all 8 steps. It will specifically test complex interactions like the ID liveness check and funding selection, followed by a mobile viewport pass to verify layout stability.
assumptions: The 'apply.html' page uses client-side JavaScript to toggle visibility of the 8 sections rather than navigating to new URLs.
The 'liveness check' in Step 5 is a simulated UI interaction (countdown) and does not require actual camera permissions.
Form validation logic exists for required fields (SSN, Address) and will trigger visible error states upon invalid input.
risk_hotspots: Step 5 (ID Verification): The liveness check modal and file upload simulation.
Step 6 (Risk Questionnaire): Logic linking income inputs to risk warnings.
Navigation: The 'Edit' links in Step 8 (Review) must correctly jump back to specific previous sections without data loss.
Mobile Layout: The prescan indicates multiple small tap targets (<44px) which may fail WCAG guidelines on mobile.

phases.title: Landing Page & Entry Audit
phases.objective: Validate marketing claims, information architecture, and entry points.
key_checks: Verify 'Start application' and 'Open an account' CTAs lead to apply.html.
Check readability of 'What you'll need' checklist.
Note visual hierarchy of value props ($0 monthly, Tax vault).
exit_criteria: Successfully navigated to apply.html from primary CTA.
Documented initial layout warnings regarding tap target sizes.

phases.title: Application Steps 1-4 (Identity & Contact)
phases.objective: Test the initial data capture flow and basic form validation.
key_checks: Step 1: Toggle eligibility checkboxes; verify 'Continue' is disabled until agreed.
Step 2: Enter personal info; test SSN masking behavior.
Step 3: Enter US address; validate ZIP code format if applicable.
exit_criteria: Progress bar updates correctly after each step.
No console errors during section transitions.
Data entered persists when moving forward.

phases.title: Complex Interactions (Steps 5-7)
phases.objective: Validate high-risk UI components: ID verification, risk logic, and funding.
key_checks: Step 5: Trigger 'Liveness check' modal; verify 3-2-1 countdown animation.
Step 6: Answer risk questions; observe if soft warnings appear based on previous income data.
Step 7: Select 'Link external bank' vs 'Fund later'; verify mock OAuth or selection state.
exit_criteria: Funding choice is clearly selected before proceeding to Review.

phases.title: Review, Edit & Submission
phases.objective: Test the summary view, navigation recovery, and final submission.
key_checks: Step 8: Verify all previous data is displayed accurately.
Click 'Edit' on a specific section (e.g., Contact); verify return to that step with data intact.
Test 'Save & continue later' functionality (if it triggers a modal or download).
Submit application; verify transition to confirmation.html.
exit_criteria: Confirmation page loads with a generated Reference ID (SOL-2026-XXXX-XX).
'Back to home' link returns to index.html.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Repeat critical path checks on mobile to identify layout breaks and touch issues.
key_checks: Re-test tap targets identified in prescan (Nav links, CTAs).
Verify the 8-step progress bar is readable/usable on narrow screens.
Check that the floating Help drawer does not obscure form inputs.
Ensure keyboard does not hide active input fields.
exit_criteria: Documented any layout shifts or unclickable elements specific to mobile.

coverage_targets.features: All 8 application steps, Liveness modal, Risk questionnaire logic, Edit navigation
coverage_targets.mobile: Full pass on iPhone SE/12 viewport dimensions

notes: Pay close attention to the 'Help' drawer content changes mentioned in the README; verify if the text actually updates per step.
Since this is a local demo, network requests for 'OAuth' or 'Uploads' will be mocked; focus on the UI feedback (spinners, success states) rather than backend connectivity.

The underlying page state shows '✓ Verified' next to the button, indicating the mock verification logic updates the UI state immediately upon interaction.

Despite the 'Verified' status and successful liveness check simulation, the global error banner 'Please fix the following: Front of ID is required' persists, and the 'Continue' button remains disabled/unclickable.

step.objective: Allow the liveness check simulation to complete and observe the post-interaction UI state to determine if the application flow can proceed despite the missing ID file upload.

Start application No credit pull · No monthly fees · A real human if anything goes sideways SOLSTICE •••• 4382 SANA FALCONER TAX VAULT $3,418.22 25% AUTO-SAVED $0 monthly No minimum balance, no maintenance fee, no per-transaction nickels. 2-minute decision Most applications are approved instantly. Funded within one business day. Tax-savings vault Tell us a %; every deposit auto-routes that share to a separate sub-account. What you'll need A US Social Security Number A government-issued photo ID (driver's license or passport) A US residential address A funding source (existing bank, debit card, or check) About 7 minutes * Deposits insured to fictional regulatory limits.
